displayDescription: A hidden lamp passes behind a paper bulb, then a far paper wall, revealing a teal connected-system outline through a narrow opening.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Paper transmission, cut-edge rim light and scattered halo are illustrative shader approximations (exponential lateral falloff per layer), not physically based light transport through paper fibres.
Each paper layer is a flat plane with a Canvas 2D mask; paper thickness and self-shadowing are not modelled.
The lamp is a uniform position with no visible bulb geometry; its presence is shown only by the light it casts on the cavity back wall and paper edges.
No reviewed preview recipes were supplied (STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes) and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json exists; the preview demonstrates the style's characteristic action instead.
Blender was not used, per instruction.

Project technology selection could not be recorded: the selection tool reported a missing host file (PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json). Actual runtime use: three (copied into runtime/ and bundled to technology-three_js-ZGqahE/index.js), local gsap.min.js, WebGL/GLSL, Canvas 2D.
